# Literature Map

## Goal

Track how different research traditions contribute to the core question:
**How does an agent recognize it should learn?**

## Thematic Clusters

- Predictive Processing / Active Inference
- Intrinsic Motivation / Curiosity
- Meta-learning and Self-Reflection
- World Models and Model-Based RL
- Safe Adaptation and Alignment

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
```
